dialogues.speaker: Zadra
dialogues.text: It will take only one hour to walk around this place. The time left can be used to...

dialogues.speaker: Zadra
dialogues.text: Oh, hey there. I'm planning my itinerary.

dialogues.speaker: Zadra
dialogues.text: Before I arrived in Fontaine, I did have a plan ready. But I just met with a nice person named Cheriez, and it seems that I'll now have to make some adjustments.

dialogues.speaker: Zadra
dialogues.text: You see, there's an art to even setting up a tour itinerary. It must be fresh and innovative, but it also needs to be rigorously managed, and you need to adapt to the situation on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Zadra
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, even filling out a form has gained an element of fun...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't bother you further, then.

dialogues.speaker: Zadra
dialogues.text: It's no issue. I was just studying my travel plans, that's all.
